offer.say: I wasn't going to ask. I'm asking. Chair, mirror, heater. Gus did one a month. You've got a better building than Gus had. Well. A building. Same building. You know what I mean.

options.text: Chair, mirror, heater. Let's finish it.
Why a mirror? Refs don't need to look good.
One thing at a time, Nell.

mirror.say: Refs need to check their collar before they walk out in front of six hundred people at a Lumber Kings game. A crooked collar and the rafters end eat you alive. Stan Szymanski once shouted 'TIE' at me. I wasn't wearing a tie.

decline.say: One thing at a time is how Gus did it. Fine. I'll be here. On my hook.

accepted.say: Lorne's the chair man. Bev says he made her a bench out of Warlocks. I'd sit on a Warlock bench. I wouldn't shoot with one.

options.text: All in. Try it for a few games.

p_mirror.say: Any mirror. I'm not fussy. Well, I'm a ref. I'm a little fussy.

options.text: A new one from Penner Hardware.
The cracked valley mirror from the washroom. With a label.

p_new.say: Clean, flat, no cracks. I'll look like a real official. It'll be a shock to everyone.

p_valley.say: The one with the five towns on it? You'd give the ref room the map of the valley? I can check my collar and the road to Kessler at once. That's the nicest thing anyone's done for an official since Shauna's crullers.

p_rooms.say: Breaker 9 is the space heater in Gus's office. Breaker 14 is a secret. Breaker 9 is just bad.

p_games.say: I sat down at the second intermission. Sat down! On a chair! I nearly called a penalty on myself for comfort.

complete.say: Hook, chair, mirror, heater. Gus's list, done. We wrote you a page in the book. Not a line. A page. Gord drew a picture of you. It's not very good. It's very sincere.

options.text: Does this mean you'll call my games kinder?
Thank Gus. It was his list.

c_read.say: 'The ice at Millbrook is good. The room is warm. The owner listens. If the D Division would stop explaining Rule 6.2 to us, it would be the best rink in the valley.' And then Gord's picture. You have a lot of hair in it.

c_kind.say: Kinder, no. Fairer, yes. A warm ref is a fair ref. That's not in the rulebook. It should be.

c_gus.say: I'll send him a postcard. Refs and Gus go way back. He used to bring us coffee and stand outside the door saying 'WE CAN'T HEAR YOU'. We could.

done.say: Best ref room in the valley. Harlow Falls has a bench and a bucket.
